title: Northbeam TechWorks Billing Basis: One Line, One Basis
content:
One line of work on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is either warranty or plan work or chargeable work, never both, and the flag on the agreement decides which before any charge is booked.

## Partly covered work

Where a job turns out to be partly covered, the covered work is recorded on its own line as warranty or plan work and the uncovered work on a chargeable line, so no line carries both.

## How the single basis is read

The line of work the entry is settled against is what identifies the line, and the entries already standing against it — what kind of entry each is and what kind of charge it records — are read before a fresh charge is booked on it. Two entries against one line of work are still distinguished by the day the occurrence took place and by the kind of charge recorded.

## Billing the customer and claiming from the plan

The clause that a customer cannot be billed for labour on a line whose charge has been written off as plan covered is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for rebilling such a line. The other limb stands: a line billed to the customer is not later claimed from the plan.

## Manufacturer warranty work

Manufacturer warranty work is never billed to the customer at all, including the crew attendance charge, and a diagnostic charge taken before the warranty was established is refunded.

## A claim the plan declines after the work

Where the plan declines the claim after the work was carried out as plan work, the line is rebilled as chargeable work with the plan's decision recorded against it.

## Points of judgement

**A job half covered by the plan.** The covered work goes on its own line as plan work and the uncovered work on a chargeable line; neither line carries both bases.

**A diagnostic charge taken before the warranty was established.** It is refunded, the work having turned out to be manufacturer warranty work, which is never billed to the customer at all.

The per-service flags this standard reads — whether the diagnostic charge is credited against the repair, whether labour is covered where a protection plan authorises the work, and whether labour is covered on manufacturer warranty work — are carried in the diagnostic and cover applicability schedules for the six TechWorks services.
